text.tspan: Static vs continuous batching: 4 GPU slots, 10 decode steps
Static batching: the batch is fixed until its LONGEST request (B) finishes
Continuous batching: a waiting request joins the moment a slot frees up
Tokens each request needs: A 3 · B 8 · C 4 · D 6 · E 3 · F 4 · G 2 · H 3 · I 2 · J 2 · K 2 · L more (… = still running)
Continuous batching re-forms the batch at EVERY decode step: finished requests leave, waiting ones join.
That's the book's "weaving requests together token by token". Result: much higher throughput.
